profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Versatile software developer with experience across the full development lifecycle, from requirement gathering and design through coding, testing, and deployment. Proficient in Agile methodologies and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Skilled in front-end and back-end development, building responsive user interfaces, querying databases, integrating with APIs, and optimizing application performance. Adheres to coding best practices, write comprehensive documentation, and leverage version control.
Demonstrates an ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies to meet project needs. Proven skills in React, Node.js, SQL, NoSQL databases, AWS cloud services, and other modern development tools.
Combine technical expertise with strong problem-solving abilities to identify and resolve issues, enhancing system stability and uptime. Focused on writing clean, maintainable code while delivering functional software that meets business requirements.
A continuous learner committed to personal and professional growth in the ever-evolving software development landscape. Experienced in collaborating within team environments and making valuable contributions through the software development process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Built www.skilledtrades.com from the ground up, launching successfully in late summer 2024.
-Continuously maintaining and enhancing the platform using Scrum methodologies, quickly addressing production issues, and developing new features.
-Designed and implemented full-stack features, including algorithms aimed at improving user retention and engagement.
-Contributed to architectural and design decisions to enhance scalability and robustness.
-Helped lead a critical last-minute migration from MongoDB to SQL while ensuring the project launched on schedule.
-Improved SEO through sitemaps, react helmet, and monitoring in Google console.
-Gained 70k+ site impressions within 6 months.
-Gained over 6000 users within 6 months.
-Developed logging infrastructure to improve app monitoring and troubleshooting
-Improved and containerized an internal tool for data scraping
-Resolved PM2 errors to bring staging sites back online
-Installed CloudWatch agents to enable CloudWatch logs for deployed environments
-Implemented logging services with type-safe utility functions
-Integrated tracing across endpoints, cron jobs, and services
-Integrated github workflows for unit testing, linting, and building code
-Integrated Klaviyo flows for gathering metrics
-Aided in fixing issues with Google Analytics to collect metrics
-Helped migrate from React to Next.js
-Designed and implemented a data processing pipeline for scraped data allowing more scrapers to be built around it
-Processed data from various sources, cleaned, transformed, stored, and made available to users
-Integrated AI to improve the enrichment of data in a data processing pipeline
-Patched infrastructure vulnerabilities
-Engineered prompts that improved data quality in AI-powered enrichment and data processing pipelines
-Integrate caching strategies
-password rotations
-implemented correct database isolation levels across endpoints
-published npm package with in-house observability tools to use across organization projects

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
-Involved in the development and launch of a new software system to replace the company KT Black's legacy CRM, contributing to the full software development lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment
-On-call support during software launch, addressed and deployed "hot" fixes to ensure smooth operations and minimize downtime.
-Ensured the reliability and performance of the application by writing unit tests, conducting thorough QA, and implementing best practices for writing files to AWS
-Utilized Agile/Scrum methodologies, attending daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software increments
-Developed and maintained SQL queries, front-end pages, and reports to provide clients with real-time access to business data
-Built and documented secure API endpoints and reusable front-end components, adhering to coding standards and promoting maintainability
-Wrote scripts to identify and resolve critical database issues, ensuring data integrity and application stability.
-Selected to join another internal team as a key contributor to the development of a new current ongoing project

positions.locationName: Mars Hill, North Carolina, United States

positions.title: STEM Mentor
positions.description:
-Selected in Fall 2022 by the head of Computer Science & Mathematics to join the inaugural group of STEM program mentors.
-Mentored 5-10 students in computer science, calculus, discrete mathematics, biology, and chemistry.
-Organized events to foster community, introduce campus resources, and develop job skills, technical competencies, and problem-solving abilities.
-Conducted weekly meetings to support students' academic progress and personal goals.
-Inspired and motivated students, leading to increased grades and academic success.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
-Volunteered as an exceptional tutor for Computer Science students at Mars Hill University, under the esteemed guidance of a Computer Science professor.
-Delivered expert, targeted tutoring in programming, optimization, and development/design to students personally referred by CS department professors.
-Offered comprehensive debugging support and crafted innovative strategies to facilitate deep understanding of diverse computer science topics.
-Specialized in tutoring rigorous coursework: Foundations in CompSci I & II, Data Structures, Advanced Programming, and Web Development.
-Proficient in multiple programming languages: C/C++, Java, JavaScript.
-Additional expertise in web technologies: HTML/CSS.

positions.title: Help Desk Technician, Intern
positions.description:
-Managed support tickets and evaluated technical issues, delivering over-the-phone assistance to diagnose and resolve complex software and hardware problems.
-Provided exceptional, patient, and attentive customer service, consistently maintaining a positive and professional attitude.
-Maintained and troubleshooted multiple operating systems, including Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android, ensuring seamless performance.
-Expertly constructed and provided comprehensive support for hardware components.
-Efficiently managed administrative privileges for users, enhancing system security and functionality.
-Installed and maintained robust security measures, including advanced software solutions and security cameras.
-Accurately maintained and updated data using AssetPanda, ensuring precise asset management.
-Skillfully assembled and tested network cables, ensuring optimal performance through expert soldering and stripping techniques.
